tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ kar gling zhi khro'i tshe 'das gnas lung gi cho ga bklag pas grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

tshe 'das gnas lung gi skabs rgyas par bdag 'jug blangs/ bsdu na rig pa'i me tog dor bas 'jug pa ni/ dril bu bsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swa badz+ra sa ma ya swa/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes rig pa'i me tog dor bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rmad po che// de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba'i// phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dang*/ oṃ/ khro la khros pas zhi mdzad pa// thugs rje khro dpal rngams pa'i tshogs// 'bar ba'i byin rlabs rmad po che// da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ de gnyis gang ltar yang gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa dang 'brel na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ oṃ/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshal// zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas gnas lung dngos la/ sbyor ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor shar sgor pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i khar tshe 'das kyi ro'am gzugs ming nṛ yig bris pa'i byang bu dri rten dang bcas pa 'god/ gzhan yang rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor dang sbyong chas/ brab rdzas/ zas gtad sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bya/ cho ga dngos la bcu gcig ste/ rten bskyed pa/ rnam shes 'gugs bstim/ lan chags sbyong ba/ khrus bya ba/ rigs drug gnas 'dren/ dbang bskur ba/ zas gtad pa/ smon lam gdab pa dang sgrib pa sbyong ba/

lam bstan cing gnas spar ba/ byang bu bsreg pa'o/ dang po ni/ dmigs rten rigs drug gi dal du bkod la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ming byang nṛ las tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/par bsam la/ gnyis pa rnam shes dgug pa ni/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol dus las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas gang du gnas kyang skad cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas rnam shes dang*/ a su nṛ tri pre du ma ma aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas rigs drug gi bag chags bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rnam shes a thung gi rnam pas rten la thim par bsam/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya lhan/ zhes pas rten la dbyer med du bag phebs te 'khod par bsam mo/ gsum pa ni/ bgegs gtor ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin brlab/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ nas ga ga na khaṃ gh+ri ha na daṃ ba l+yā de swā hā/ lan gsum gyis zhi ba dang*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐/ sogs lan gsum gyis phyed ma dang*/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rang rig stong gsal rig pa'i mdangs: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: rab 'jigs khrag 'thung sprul pa'i tshogs: snang la rang bzhin med pa yis: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: tshe 'das 'di la gnod byed cing : srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshin lcag bgegs:

nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ ces dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs dkar gyis brab/ gtor ma phyir bskyal ba ni drag po'i sbyong ba'o/ bzhi pa ni/ me long nang dkyil 'khor pa'i snang brnyan 'char bar khrus gsol zhing*/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ ka ya bhi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ zhes sku phyi'o/ khrus chu de nyid bum par blugs pas ming byang bkru zhing*/ rnam dag gtsang dngas lha yi chu// yid 'ong dri zhim gaṅga'i rgyun// phyag rgya ye shes bum pa'i chus// tshe 'das sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ces dang*/ rtsa sngags dang yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bkru/ gzhan yang*/ hūm̐: 'di ni pha rol phyin bcu'i chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyongs mdzad pa: phar phyin bcu la legs 'god chu: phar phyin chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes dang yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ces brjod cing bkru/ zhar byung du dug sbyong ba ni/ ku shas rten la byab cing*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bde gshegs rigs lnga dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams// 'jig rten kun tu bla na med// bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis// khyod kyi nyon mongs dug rnams ni// rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig /'byung bzhis byab cing*/ 'byung bzhi dug gi pha yin te: 'byung bzhi dug gi ma yang yin:

bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams 'byung bzhi'i nang du song : gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis: tshe 'das lus brjes bu khyod kyi: dug rnams gtan nas dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags dang yi ge brgya pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sogs brjod la khrus bya'o/ lnga pa ni/ gsol gdab chos bshad skyabs su gsol// dbang bskur bya zhing lan chags sbyang*// bsreg dang bkru zhing gnas nas drangs/ zhes brgyad las/ dang po ni/ tshe 'das kyi gsol ba gdab par bsam la/ kyai ma mgon po thugs rje can// rigs drug gnas su ltung ba yi/ skyabs bral mgon med sems can la: thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol: gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ kyai ma: tshe 'phos lus brjes bar do'i yid lus khyod: sngon chad ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: dug gsum gyis bcings ngan song gsum du mnar: deng nas brtsam ste rgyal ba'i thugs rje yis: pho nyas bzung ste rigs drug gnas nas drangs: don 'bras 'dod phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: 'dren pa thub chen drug la gsol ba thob: ces gdams la/ gsum pa ni/ tshe 'das kyis gus pa chen pos/ nyon drug gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: phyin drug chos thob nyon mongs rnam par dag: rigs drug thub pa rang rtags phyag rgya can: 'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: bcom ldan thub pa drug la skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs su 'gro bar bsam/ bzhi pa la gnyis las/ thog mar phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ thub drug so so'i phyag mtshan thogs la/ hūm̐: tsha grang skyobs byed me chu bsil drod ldan: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal las grol nas: na ra ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

āḥ rin chen sgrom gyi bum pa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: pre ta ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: pre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ: shes rab rig pa'i pusti 'di: dus gsum sangs rgyas zhi khro'i gsung : tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: tir+ya ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: tri ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hāḥ shes rab don mtshon ral gri dang : bdud kyi mtshon srung go cha 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sbyor sgrol te: zhi khro rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan 'dis: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: he sa ka yi sdug bsngal zhi bar shog: su sarba du khaḥsarba karma pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ swā: longs spyod bdud kyi dbyings 'joms pa'i: pi waṃ snyan pa'i don byed 'dis: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: skye ba gcig gis las rab rdzogs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bir+ya kharga tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐: rin chen par bu lhung bzed na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: gseg shang drang srong sgra sgrogs 'di: thugs rtags zhi khro'i lha yi rtags: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: a wa dhu ti'i dbang thob shog: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha a ba ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gnyis pa bum dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: rigs drug skye sgo bcad nas su: zhing khams lnga la dbang bsgyur shog: hūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca āḥ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca āḥ swā rat+na a bhi ṣiñca āḥ aṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hā karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ lnga pa ni/ gtor ma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gis bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs brlabs/ hūm̐: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das lan chags bu lon bsnyegs pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcag lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la:

tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces bsngo/ drug pa ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: nga rgyal log lta the tshom rnams: 'di dag 'jig rten dug yin te: kun bzang zhi khro dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi: nyon mongs dri ma dag gyur cig: ces dang*/ rtsa sngags yig brgya sgrib sbyong gi sngags sogs sbrel ba brjod cing bye mas brab pas ye shes kyi mes rigs drug gi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs par bsam/ bdun pa ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs drug po sbyongs byed cing : phar phyin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon mongs dri ma dag gyur cig: ces dang yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bkrus pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis nyon mongs pa'i thal ba'ang sbyangs par bsam la/ brgyad pa ni/ sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sa yin pas: bor ro spang ngo rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: mtho ris thar pa'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: ces brjod cing rigs drug gi gnas nas drangs/ rdo rjes phyi lam bcad de dbang stegs su bkod la/ tshe 'das nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro bar bsam zhing tshig rnams brjod par mos la/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang : mchog gsum zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: de ring nyid nas bdag skyabs mchi: mgon po thugs rje can rnams kyis: 'khor ba'i sems can bdag lta bu: bar do'i gnas na mgon med cing : 'jigs pas mnar ba bdag la dgongs: thog med dus nas spyad pa yis: las ngan sgrib pas bcings pa bdag: mtha' med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las: bde chen gnas su drang du gsol: bar do'i 'jigs pa gshin rje'i 'phrang : nyam nga'i gnas su 'khyams pa'i 'gro:

nyon mongs gdung bas gzir ba rnams: byams pa'i thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol: ces gsol ba gdab/ drug pa ni/ bla mas brda sprod pa dang las rdor ram yon bdag gang rung gis rjes zlos byas la maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ro'am byang bu gang yin la gdong g.yogs me tog gtad pa sogs lan len bgyi tshul gang mtshams bya zhing rjes zlos kyi tshig don rnams kyang tshe 'das kyis brjod cing 'dun pa'ang don gang dang gang yin pa de lta bu gtad par mos la/ khyad par gang zag don shes pa'i gshin po rnams la ni bla mas kyang brda sprod rnams kyang gsal zhing skabs phyed par bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:gis mig dar bcings/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐:gis me tog gtad/ thal mo sbyar te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma mgon po thugs rje can: bdag cag 'gro ba ma lus pa: log pa'i lam du zhugs gyur pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam bstan 'tshal: zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa'i lan du gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ e ma 'dir 'dus skal ldan las can rnams: sngon chad ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: dug gsum gyis bcings ngan song gsum du mnar: deng nas bzung ste rgyal ba'i thugs rje yis: pho nyas bzung ste dkyil 'khor gral du bkod: don 'bras 'dod phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: sku gsum zhing khams pho brang 'dir shog cig: bla med don gyi snying po sbyin par bya: rgyud sbyang ba ni/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su maid pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par bzhugs pa la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba mngon sum du sad pa'i spyan sngar dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang :

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: bdag nyid gus pas skyabs su mchi: kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs la: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar: gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi: zhes lan gsum gyis spyi dang khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro bya/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro dgongs: 'di bzung bla maid byang chub bar: 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis: smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang : sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bzung bar bgyi: zhes lan gsum gyis smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa kun 'dus pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig rnams bzung bar bya snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro dgongs: bdag gis 'di bzung byang chub bar: dkon mchog gsum bzung mi spang ngo : rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang : byang chub sems ni spang mi bya: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : zhes lan gsum gyis sngags sdom blangs la rigs brtag phyir me tog 'bul ba la dang po dam ye dbyer med rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo dbye ba ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ ces dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi phye bar gyur/ hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes rgyal thebs kyis rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nang du khrid/

de nas dkyil 'khor gyi khyams la gnas pa'i phyag dang bcas te me tog 'bul bar mos la 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag cag rig pa'i me tog 'di: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: yi dam lha la 'bab par shog: pra tits+tsha hoḥ zhes dor/ gang la babs pa'i lha de spyan drangs nas tshe 'das la thim par bsam/ me tog mgo bor bcings shing*/ hūm̐ badz+ra satwa ā we sha ya āḥ mig dbye ba ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis: rab rib ling tog bsal ba ltar: de bzhin bu khyod ma rig pa'i: ling tog bdag gis bsal bar bya: badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ zhes gdong g.yogs dkrol/ mthong ba bstan pa ni/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya zhes bstan pas/ bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum mthong bar gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag gi lha dang skal pa mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams legs par song nas zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor der mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i phyir ye shes pa dbab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ tshe 'das de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dbang stegs seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'/ thugs kar zhi ba/ spyi bor khrag 'thung*/ mgrin par rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yab yum dang bcas pa rnams gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku dang yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin spyan drangs te dbyer med du thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ badz+ra a we sha ya a we sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ dngos gzhi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/

dngos gzhi dbang la'ang phyi phan byed rig pa'i dbang lnga*/ bum dbang dngos/ nang nus pa 'jug pa lha sku'i phyag rgya'i dbang rnams rim par bskur ba yin te/ slob dpon gyis rnam bum spyi bor bzhag la/ sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba: nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms pa yi: lha yi bdud rtsi dag pa 'dis: mi bskyod pa ru dbang bskur ro: hūm̐ badz+ra dharmā dhartu dz+nya na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: zhes bum chu spyi bor btegs la/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar na skal ldan tshe las 'das pa che ge khyod kyi zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod par gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ dbu rgyan bcing zhing rna ltag g.yas su bum chu btegs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che: nga rgyal rtog pa rnam par 'joms: chags med sbyin pa'i dbu rgyan 'dis: rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro: swā rat+na sa ma ti dz+nya na rat+na saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: rin 'byung gi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil ba las rin 'byung sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar na skal ldan che ge khyod kyi nga rgyal dag /tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan du gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ rdo rje mgo thog dang lag g.yas par gtad cing ltag par bum chu btegs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang : mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba las: 'dod chags rtog pa rnam par 'joms:

rdo rje chos su dbang bskur ro: oṃ pad+ma pra t+ya bik+ṣa ṇa dz+nya na a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil ba las snang ba mtha' yas sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar na skal ldan che ge khyod kyi 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po snang ba mtha' yas su gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ dril bu bsil zhing lag g.yon du gtad/ rna ltag g.yon du bum chu btegs la/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis: 'gro don mnyam med dril bu 'dis: phrag dog rtog pa rnam par 'joms: gnyis su med par dbang bskur ro: hā kṛ t+ya a nu te dz+nyā na pa de badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil pa las don yod grub pa sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar na skal ldan che ge khyod kyi phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub par gnas 'gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ rdor dril spyi bor dkrol zhing gsang mtshan yid la bya/ bum chu dpral bar btegs la/ rdo rje ming gis dbang bskur bas: gti mug rtog pa rnam par 'joms: cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa'i: rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags: oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dar+sha dz+nya na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ: rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil ba las rnam snang sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/

de ltar na skal ldan che ge khyod kyi gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad du gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ de dag gis ma rig pa lnga sbyangs nas rig pa'i ye shes lnga thob par byed pa yin pas rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes grags so/ de nas bum dbang dngos bskur ba la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan tshe 'das la: rigs 'dus bde gshegs zhi khro yi: bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas bum pa spyi bor 'jog cing bum chu myang*/ hūm̐: rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dbang lus la thob par shog: hūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca a āḥ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca a āḥ swā rat+na a bhi ṣiñca a āḥ aṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca a āḥ hā karma a bhi ṣiñca a āḥ zhi khro 'dus pa'i rang bzhin ye shes drug gi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil pa las rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar na skal ldan tshe las 'das pa khyod la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol ba yin no/ des 'gro don byed pa'i phyir phyag mtshan gyi dbang 'di gang zag lam pa lta bu la bya yi mi nag skye bo sogs la mi dgos pas dbye bsal shes par bya ste/ spro na phyag mtshan gtad la/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che: pad+ma rgya gram thugs kyi rtags: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: 'khor lo lnga la dbang rdzogs shog: badz+ra tsakra rat+na pad+ma karma kharga a bhi ṣiñca āḥ des rigs lnga'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i phrin las la dbang 'byor ba yin no/

nang nus pa 'jug pa lha sku'i phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan tshe 'das la: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab nas/ tshe 'das nyid seng ges btegs pa'i khri la bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum dang bcas pa'i rnam pas 'khod pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon nas gnyis med du thim par gyur/pa'i mos pa dang bcas so so'i tsakli thogs la/ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: kun bzang yab yum dbang bskur bas: yid chos rnam par dag pa yi: chos sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: dharmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: rigs lnga yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga po gnas dag nas: longs sku rigs lnga'i dbang thob shog: oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hāḥ saṃ bho kā ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: bde gshegs yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'byung lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: rigs lnga yum lnga'i dbang thob shog: mum̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: sems dpa' rab 'byams dbang thob shog: bā+o dhi satwa a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: sems ma rab 'byams dbang thob shog: āḥ.a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: thub chen drug gi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs drug po gnas dag nas: sprul sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sgo ba bzhi yi dbang bskur bas:

rtag chad mu bzhi gnas dag nas: phrin las rab 'byams dbang thob shog: shin+taṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wa shaṃ ma ra ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐: badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: che mchog yab yum dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs ma spangs gnas dag nas: khrag 'thung rab 'byams dbang thob shog: ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā kro ti shwa ri a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: dug lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: khrag 'thung yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: yul lnga'i rtog pa rang grol nas: kro ti yum lnga'i dbang thob shog: kro ti shwa ri pañca a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: kau'u rī brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: mkha' 'gro rab 'byams dbang thob shog: hā a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sengha brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: phra men rab 'byams dbang thob shog: he a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs rtog tshogs gnas dag nas: ma mo rab 'byams dbang thob shog: bh+yo a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes so so'i dbang bskur ro/ de ltar che ge khyod la lus smin par byed pa bum pa lha yi dbang bskur bas 'di ltar snang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dam pa rigs brgya'i lha'i 'khor lo rang rig ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa'o/

de nas gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ sogs dam tshig khas blangs zhing gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo/ gal te dbang bskur de nyid mi lcog pa'am grangs bsogs lta bu'i skabs spros pa shin tu bsdus pa'i dbang byas na/ tshe 'das kyi brjod par bsam la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ thal mo sbyar te/ e ma mgon po thugs rje can: bdag 'dra'i sems can 'khor bar 'khyams: log pa'i lam du zhugs lags pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam bstan 'tshal: dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug tu gsol: zhes gsol ba gdab/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams: tshe 'das bdag la dgongs su gsol: dkon mchog rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : zhes sdom pa bzung*/ che ge skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nya na dhartu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: badz+ra ā we sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes ye shes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi'i slad du phyi rin po che'i bum pa/ nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gnas pa'i sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams skad cig gis gsal ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang : nang na zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog rnams: tshe 'das khyod la bab pa yis: phung khams lha dang lha mor gyur: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: de ltar zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i rang bzhin ye shes drug gi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/

lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ dbang gnas su bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma 'khyil pa las rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan par gyur: ces brjod cing bsam/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor zhing dbang don gyi ye shes bstim par bsam la shis pa brjod pas mnga' gsol bar bya'o/ bdun pa ni/ bza' btung gi dngos po gtsang ma chab bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par gyur/par bsam la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bhi shwa sogs kyi nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlabs/ hūm̐: nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje sems: sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor bas: ye shes chen po'i 'phro 'du las: 'dod pa thams cad tshim byed pa: bcud chen ro mchog brgya ldan pa'i: bza' dang btung ba'i tshogs rnams dang : 'dod dgu 'byor pa rgya mtsho yis: khyod kyi re ba bskang bar bya: khyad par brtse gdung gnyen rnams kyis: gdung ba'i skad kyis khyod bos nas: 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags kyis sbar te bsngo: dga' dang spro ba'i sems kyis ni: zhen pa med par longs spyod cig: bkres skom gdung ba kun zhi nas: 'dod yon dpal la spyod par shog: ces bsngos pas des kyang bdag gir bzung nas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur pa'i mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal la sa pā ri wa ra ma hā sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: ces brjod cing rol mo bya/ slar yang tshe 'das kyi don/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du: longs spyod zad pa med pa dang : rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par: rang dbang du ni spyod par shog: ces smon lam gdab: brgyad pa ni/ 'di nas shar lho nub byang dang : dbus kyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten na: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams yod: thams cad 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin te: 'byung lnga shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni 'byung chen te:

'byung ba'i snying po mi 'gyur ba'i: yi ge lnga ru rnam par dag: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing : zhing mchog lnga ru skyes gyur te: yum chen lnga dang gnyis med shog: ces brjod la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i mthu dang ldan par bsam/ dgu pa ni/ sems dpa' lnga yi sku me long la shar ba bstan cing*/ kyai ma: mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyob par shog: ye shes lnga yi ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras sa snying nam snying spyan ras gzigs: phyag rdor sgrib pa rnam sel thugs rje yis: tshe 'das sgo lnga'i dbang po'i nad bsal nas: zag med yum lnga'i bde la spyod par shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' lnga : lha mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: ces brjod pas sems can rnams yongs su smin pa'i mthu dang ldan par bsam/ bcu pa lam bstan pa dang gnas spar ba gnyis las/ dang po snang gsal gyi mtshon par byas la/ hūm̐: rang bzhin shugs kyis drangs ba'i dran pas nyon: 'khor ba'i rba rlabs mun ltar 'khyams pa la: thugs rje'i shugs kyi sgron me 'di bstan pas: ye shes 'od la rtag tu bde bar shog: ces dang*/ 'di nas shar lho nub byang dang : dbus kyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten na: mngon dga' la sogs zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs mchog lnga : gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: zhing mchog de ru skyes gyur nas: bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la: tshe las 'das pa 'di nyid kyi: phung po lnga po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: gnyis pa gnas spar ba ni: thabs shes zung 'brel mda' gzhu'i 'phrul 'khor gyis mtshon te/

hūm̐: thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste: ye shes thugs rje'i shugs kyi rgyud dang ldan: bla na med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa ru: tshe 'das mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: ces dang*/ zhing khams 'di nas dbus kyi phyogs rol na: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi myes ni: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po bzhugs: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos nyid kun tu bzang mo zhes bya yod: rgyal ba'i sras mchog rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs: yum chen nam mkha'i dbyings phyug ces bya yod: rigs bzhi yab yum gtso 'khor grangs med yod: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: ya mtshan bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni sdug po bkod pa'i zhing : zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭaḥ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gcig tu gyur te rtsal po ches mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas nas/ slar yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig /ces dngos su khyab byed kyi zhing 'og min sdug po bkod par gnas spar nas zhor la khyab bya phyogs bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i zhing khams sam rigs kyi gtso bo rnams kyi spyan sngar son nas zhal mthong*/ dbang bskur/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung ste/ dbus rdo rje sems dpa'i sras su mngon par byang chub pa'i so so'i brnyes par bsam la smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab/ bcu gcig pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bā+o dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nya na dhartu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐:

ces brjod pas/ mar me'i dbus su skad cig gis dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i me lha kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor bkra lam gyis gsal ba'i sku las ye shes kyi 'od zer byung bas tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dmigs med ka dag gi dbyings su sbyangs par bsam la/ hūm̐: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: rnam shes tshogs brgyad thab khung du: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: nyon mongs rgya mtsho skem par shog: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phung po la: stong pa nyid kyi me sbar bas: gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par shog: dug gsum 'dus pa'i phung po la: sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar bas: sku gsum lhun gyis 'grub par shog: dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar bas: ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la: yum chen bzhi yis me sbar bas: tshad med bzhi dang ldan nas kyang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub nas: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par shog: ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa dang mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sogs bzla bzhin pas bsregs// thal ba sngags bzla bzhin bum chus bran la dri zhim pa'i 'jim pa dang sbyar nas sats+tsha gdab/ rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas par bya'o/ de'ang 'di lta bu'i gnas lung kyi cho gas lam dang 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs par mtshon pa yin te/ rigs drug gi gnas nas drangs pa yan gyis tshogs lam dang*/ dbang bskur bas mthong lam/ smon lam gdab pa dang dbang po'i sgrib pa bsal sbyong man gyis mthu thob pas bsgom lam/ lam bstan pas mi slob pa'i lam/ gnas spar zhing byang bu bsregs pas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan 'das pa'i 'bras bu/ sats+tsha gdab pas slar yang mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par brtson par byed pa'o/ 'di slob dpon chen po'i rdo rje'i gsung bklag pas grub pa bzhugs na'ang cho ga bsdus pa'i dbang du byas nas rdo rje'i gsungs snying por dril nas skabs su bab pa'i rnam bzhag dang mtshams sbyor cung zad kyis brgyan te bkod pa yin no/
ces pa 'di lo chen chog bsgrigs zhi khro sdig sgrib rnam par sbyong ba nas khol du phyungs pa yin no/
